landing.case_studies.title: Case Studies
landing.case_studies.headline: Real Results
landing.case_studies.description: Deep dives into projects where complex problems met simple, powerful solutions.
landing.case_studies.case1_challenge: A logistics company needed a warehouse management system with 3D spatial tracking, AI-powered operations, and multi-role approval workflows — all built by a solo developer.
landing.case_studies.case1_solution: Built a full-stack ERP with React Three Fiber for 3D warehouse visualization, tRPC for type-safe APIs, and an AI SDK-powered assistant that answers natural language queries about inventory.
landing.case_studies.case1_result: 10 transaction types, role-based access for 6 permission levels, real-time pallet tracking across 500+ storage locations, and an AI assistant handling 80% of routine data queries.
landing.case_studies.case2_challenge: A mid-size manufacturer was drowning in spreadsheets — production planning, quality control, and shipping all lived in separate Excel files with no single source of truth.
landing.case_studies.case2_solution: Designed and built a unified production management system with bill-of-materials tracking, work order routing, quality inspection checkpoints, and real-time production dashboards.
landing.case_studies.case2_result: Reduced production planning time by 65%, eliminated data entry errors across departments, and gave management real-time visibility into factory floor operations.
landing.case_studies.case3_challenge: An e-commerce brand wanted customers to customize products in 3D before purchase — changing colors, materials, and components in real-time with instant pricing updates.
landing.case_studies.case3_solution: Built a React Three Fiber configurator with real-time material swapping, component toggling, dynamic pricing, and a shareable configuration link system.
landing.case_studies.case3_result: 28% increase in conversion rate, 40% reduction in return rate, and average session time increased by 3.5x as customers explored configurations.

landing.faq.title: FAQ
landing.faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
landing.faq.description: Common questions about working with me — from process to pricing to technology.
landing.faq.q1_answer: Most projects take 8-16 weeks from kickoff to production. A simple dashboard might take 4 weeks, while a full ERP system with 3D features typically takes 12-16 weeks. I provide a detailed timeline during the Discovery phase.
landing.faq.q2_answer: I work on a fixed-price project basis with checkpoint payments. You deposit before work starts, then pay at each milestone delivery — including the final handoff. You only pay for what you've seen and approved. Typical projects range from $8,000 to $40,000 depending on complexity.
landing.faq.q3_question: Can you work with our existing systems?
landing.faq.q3_answer: Yes. I have extensive experience integrating with REST APIs, GraphQL, databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), and legacy systems. If your system has an API, I can connect to it.
landing.faq.q4_question: What happens after the project is delivered?
landing.faq.q4_answer: Every project includes 30 days of post-launch support. After that, I offer ongoing maintenance retainers starting at $1,500/month for bug fixes, small features, and performance monitoring.
landing.faq.q5_question: Do you work with teams or only solo?
landing.faq.q5_answer: I primarily work solo, which means faster communication and no overhead. For larger projects, I can bring in a trusted designer or DevOps specialist — but I remain your single point of contact throughout.
landing.faq.q6_question: What technologies do you specialize in?
landing.faq.q6_answer: My core stack is React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Three.js/React Three Fiber for 3D. I also work with Python, Prisma, tRPC, and AI/LLM integration (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain). I choose the right tool for the job, not the trendiest one.
